create_TO_instance: create a TO topology optimization experiment function with a configurable grid size n
run_TO_simulation: run the TO _simulate_to method to evaluate an n by n numpy array against a target pattern
test_TO_class: test the TO class by instantiating it and calling _simulate_to with a random numpy array
review_TO_simulate: review the TO _simulate_to method which computes a cost combining pattern mismatch and smoothness penalty
summarize_TO_class: summarize the TO class extending ExperimentFunction for topology optimization benchmarking with grid-based simulation
